title: IPv4 Dynamic PAT at the Edge
summary: Configure and verify Port Address Translation (NAT Overload) on a Cisco ISR 4321 edge router, translating private RFC 1918 branch LAN traffic to a single public IP address to access external services.
learning_objectives: Differentiate between Static NAT, Dynamic NAT, and Port Address Translation (NAT Overload)
Configure a standard access control list (ACL) to identify internal private traffic eligible for translation
Designate inside and outside NAT interfaces using ip nat inside and ip nat outside
Configure dynamic PAT using the ip nat inside source list interface overload command
Verify dynamic translations and interface counters using show ip nat translations and show ip nat statistics

source.origin: Independently authored network services curriculum guide based on IETF RFC 3022 standards and Cisco IOS configuration documentation
